summary: Small maximum singleton third-volume does not dimension-freely force a rank-two hub leaf block close to C Sym_2 C^T plus diagonal. In the target-valid Walsh family A_N=[[0,C^T],[C,u u^T]] with C,u orthonormal flat Walsh columns, every singleton augmentation has Gamma_k^2=(N-3)/N^2 so max Gamma_k tends to zero, but the aggregate sum is (N-3)/N and the Frobenius distance to C Sym_2 C^T plus diagonal is at least sqrt((N-3)/N), tending to one. This refutes only the max-singleton stability interface, not QFORM. The same family is uniformly paid by determinant-distributed grouped Pluecker/Fresnel smoothing.
